_comment: OS COMMAND INJECTION via OOB — REAL (must CONFIRM with a real interactsh callback). Drives the cmdi_target lab (GET /diag?host=), which concatenates `host` into a shell command. The detector injects a battery of context payloads carrying a UNIQUE interactsh domain; the shell executes one and calls back out-of-band, and CONFIRMED requires that the received callback's token matches the one injected. Needs OUTBOUND network + a reachable public interactsh server. Boot the lab first: python -m uvicorn cmdi_target.main:app --port 8005. Run: python run.py cmdi --config examples/run.cmdi_real.json
